title: Three Years and One Short Clock
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：midnight　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 midnight 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the keeper ① marked the midnight that no traveller in the tower would have measured, and he said the marking was the whole of the year. The ② midnight, meaning the hour itself and not the clock, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a midnight, he said, is the only thing in a tower that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ midnight in that tower had the same short clock beside it, and the ④ midnight at the far stair, meaning the bell they kept for the children to ring and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A midnight, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the keeper said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the midnight was the whole of the matter, meaning the silence and not the hour. The ⑥ midnight, meaning the silence and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; midnight, he said, is either something you mark or the only word that means both an hour and a silence. He said the silence is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ midnight had become a line in a calendar, and the calendar had become an argument about the short clock. The ⑧ midnight of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in January, was one tower and three years of measuring; midnight, he said, is either the bell at the far stair or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ midnight I remember is the hour measured in the calendar, which closed in 1987 and is still measured as the quietest in the tower. A ⑩ midnight, my mother said in 1989, is the only hour that improves by being measured; every midnight, she said, is a silence that has agreed to look like an hour. She said the silence was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 午夜；子夜（指钟楼里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 午夜；子夜（指那个午夜本身，与小小的座钟相对）
C. 固定搭配：mark the midnight 记下这一个午夜
D. n. 午夜；子夜（指留给孩子们敲的那一口）
E. n. 午夜之事（抽象总称，指一处钟楼的午夜之事）
F. n. 午夜；子夜（指年历里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 午夜、寂静（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 寂静（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: marked the midnight that no traveller in the tower would have measured
The midnight, meaning the hour itself and not the clock
the midnight at the far stair
the midnight was the whole of the matter
the midnight had become a line in a calendar
The midnight of the whole thing
A midnight, my mother said in 1989

answers.why: mark the midnight 意为“记下这一个午夜”，1980 年那位守夜人把钟楼里没有一位过路人肯测量的一个午夜做了一遍。
midnight 意为“午夜；子夜”，指那个午夜本身而不是小小的座钟，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被测量。
midnight 意为“午夜；子夜”，指钟楼里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一座小小的座钟。
midnight 意为“午夜；子夜”，指最远那道旋梯的留给孩子们敲的那一口，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
midnight 意为“午夜、寂静”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个寂静就是那件事的全部。
midnight 意为“寂静”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个午夜，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
midnight 意为“午夜；子夜”，指年历里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1985 年这一个成了年历里的一行。
midnight 意为“午夜之事”，守夜人一月写道，整件事的午夜之事是一处钟楼和三个年头的测量。
midnight 意为“午夜；子夜”，我记得的是年历里测量过的那一个，1987 年走完了，至今仍被说成钟楼里最安静的一个。
midnight 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，午夜是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的午夜。
